verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ተገምረ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወዐደዉ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፤
verses.translation: And when the people had completely passed over Jordan, the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,

translations.lxx: And when the people had completely passed over Jordan, the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over Jordan, that the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
translations.ron: După ce a isprăvit tot poporul de trecut Iordanul; a grăit Domnul către Iosua şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπεὶ συνετέλεσε πᾶς ὁ λαὸς διαβαίνων τὸν Ἰορδανην, καὶ εἶπε, Κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ, λέγων,

verses.geez: ንሣእ ፡ ዐሠርተ ፡ ወክልኤተ ፡ ዕደወ ፡ አሐደ ፡ አሐደ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ እምነ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ነገድ ።
verses.translation: Take men from the people, one of each tribe,

translations.lxx: Take men from the people, one of each tribe,
translations.kjv: Take you twelve men out of the people, out of every tribe a man,
translations.ron: "Ia din popor doisprezece bărbaţi, câte un om din fiecare seminţie,
translations.grk: ταραλαβὼν ἄνδρας ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ, ἕνα ἀφʼ ἑκάστης φυλῆς,

verses.geez:
ወአዝዞሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንሥኡ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እምዝየ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ቆማ ፡ እገሪሆሙ ፡ ለካህናት
                  ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወክልኤ ፡ ዕበነ ፡ ከዋዋተ ፡ ወንሥእዎን ፡ ምስሌክሙ ፡ ወዕቀብዎን ፡ በበ ፡ ሰራዊትክሙ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ኀደርክሙ ፡
                  ህየ ፡ በሌሊት ።
verses.translation: and charge them; and ye shall take out of the midst of Jordan twelve fit stones, and having carried them across together with yourselves, place them in your camp, where ye shall encamp for the night.

translations.lxx: and charge them; and ye shall take out of the midst of Jordan twelve fit stones, and having carried them across together with yourselves, place them in your camp, where ye shall encamp for the night.
translations.kjv: And command ye them, saying, Take you hence out of the midst of Jordan, out of the place where the priests’ feet stood firm, twelve stones, and ye shall carry them over with you, and leave them in the lodging place, where ye shall lodge this night.
translations.ron: Şi le porunceşte: "Luaţi din mijlocul Iordanului douăsprezece pietre, duceţi-le cu voi şi le puneţi în tabăra voastră, unde aveţi să tăbărâţi la noapte".
translations.grk: σύνταξον αὐτοῖς· καὶ ἀνέλεσθε ἐκ μέσου τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἑτοίμους δώδεκα λίθους, καὶ τούτους διακομίσαντες ἅμα ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς, θέτε αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ στρατοπεδίᾳ ὑμῶν, οὗ ἐὰν παρεμβάλητε ἐκεῖ τὴν νύκτα.

verses.geez:
ወጸውዐ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ዐሠርተ ፡ ወክልኤተ ፡ ዕደወ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ክቡራኒሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አሐደ ፡ አሐደ ፡
                  ብእሴ ፡ እምነ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ነገድ ።
verses.translation: And Joshua having called twelve men of distinction among the children of Israel, one of each tribe,

translations.lxx: And Joshua having called twelve men of distinction among the children of Israel, one of each tribe,
translations.kjv: Then Joshua called the twelve men, whom he had prepared of the children of Israel, out of every tribe a man:
translations.ron: Şi a chemat Iosua doisprezece bărbaţi pe care şi-i alesese dintre fiii lui Israel, câte un om din fiecare seminţie,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνακαλεσάμενος Ἰησοῦς δώδεκα ἄνδρας τῶν ἐνδόξων ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, ἕνα ἀφʼ ἑκάστης φυλῆς,

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ንዑ ፡ ወአምጽኡ ፡ ቅድሜየ ፡ ወቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ወንሥኡ ፡
                  እምህየ ፡ አሐተ ፡ አሐተ ፡ እብነ ፡ ወጹሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መታክፍቲክሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ኍለቊሆሙ ፡ ለዐሠርቱ ፡ ወክልኤቱ ፡ ነገደ ፡
                  እስራኤል ፤
verses.translation: said to them, Advance before me in the presence of the Lord into the midst of Jordan, and each having taken up a stone from thence, let him carry it on his shoulders, according to the number of the twelve tribes of Israel:

translations.lxx: said to them, Advance before me in the presence of the Lord into the midst of Jordan, and each having taken up a stone from thence, let him carry it on his shoulders, according to the number of the twelve tribes of Israel:
translations.kjv: And Joshua said unto them, Pass over before the ark of the LORD your God into the midst of Jordan, and take you up every man of you a stone upon his shoulder, according unto the number of the tribes of the children of Israel:
translations.ron: Şi le-a zis: "Mergeţi înaintea chivotului Domnului Dumnezeului vostru, în mijlocul Iordanului, şi luaţi de acolo şi ridicaţi pe umerii voştri fiecare câte o piatră, după numărul celor douăsprezece seminţii ale lui Israel,
translations.grk: εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, προσαγάγετε ἔμπροσθέν μου πρὸ προσώπου Κυρίου εἰς μέσον τοῦ Ἰροδάνου· καὶ ἀνελόμενος ἐκεῖθεν ἕκαστος λίθον, ἀράτω ἐπὶ τῶν ὤμων αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν δώδεκα φυλῶν τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ,

verses.geez:
ከመ ፡ ይኵናክሙ ፡ ተአምረ ፡ ወይንበራክሙ ፡ ለዘላፉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተስእለከ ፡ ወልድከ ፡ ጌሠመ ፡ ወይቤለከ ፡ ምንት
                  ፡ እማንቱ ፡ እላንቱ ፡ እበን ፡ ለክሙ ፤
verses.translation: that these may be to you continually for an appointed sign, that when thy son asks thee in future, saying, What are these stones to us?

translations.lxx: that these may be to you continually for an appointed sign, that when thy son asks thee in future, saying, What are these stones to us?
translations.kjv: That this may be a sign among you, that when your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean ye by these stones?
translations.ron: Ca să vă fie acestea puse pentru totdeauna ca semn în mijlocul vostru şi, când vă vor întreba mâine copiii voştri şi vor zice: Ce înseamnă aici pietrele acestea?
translations.grk: ἵνα ὑπάρχωσιν ὑμῖν οὗτοι εἰς σημεῖον κείμενον διαπαντός· ἵνα ὅταν ἐρωτᾷ σε ὁ υἱός σου αὔριον λέγων, τί εἰσιν οἱ λιθοι οὗτοι ἡμῖν;

verses.geez:
ወንግሮ ፡ አንተ ፡ ለወልድከ ፡ ወበሎ ፡ እስመ ፡ ነጽፈ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ተከዚ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡
                  ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ዘኵሉ ፡ ምድር ፡ እንዘ ፡ ተዐዱ ፡ ወይኩናክሙ ፡ እላንቱ ፡ እበን ፡ ተዝካረ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል
                  ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ።
verses.translation: then thou mayest explain to thy son, saying, The river Jordan was dried up from before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the whole earth, when it passed it: and these stones shall be for a memorial for you for the children of Israel for ever.

translations.lxx: then thou mayest explain to thy son, saying, The river Jordan was dried up from before the ark of the covenant of the Lord of the whole earth, when it passed it: and these stones shall be for a memorial for you for the children of Israel for ever.
translations.kjv: Then ye shall answer them, That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD; when it passed over Jordan, the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever.
translations.ron: Atunci veţi spune fiilor voştri: Apele Iordanului s-au despărţit înaintea chivotului legământului Domnului a tot pământul, când acesta l-a trecut. Şi aşa pietrele acestea vor fi pentru fiii lui Israel amintire pentru vecie".
translations.grk: Καὶ σὺ δηλώσεις τῷ υἱῷ σου, λέγων, ὅτι ἐξέλιπεν ὁ Ἰορδάνης ποταμὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου κιβωτοῦ διαθήκης Κυρίου πάσης τῆς γῆς, ὡς διέβαινεν αὐτόν· καὶ ἔσονται οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι ὑμῖν μνημόσυνον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος.

verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአያሱስ ፡ ወነሥኡ ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወክልኤ ፡
                  እበነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተገምሩ ፡ ዐዲወ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡
                  እስራኤል ፡ ወዐቀብዎን ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ ፡ ወሤምዎን ፡ በህየ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did so, as the Lord commanded Joshua; and they took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, (as the Lord commanded Joshua, when the children of Israel had completely passed over,) and carried these stones with them into the camp, and laid them down there.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel did so, as the Lord commanded Joshua; and they took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, (as the Lord commanded Joshua, when the children of Israel had completely passed over,) and carried these stones with them into the camp, and laid them down there.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
translations.ron: Şi au făcut fiii lui Israel aşa cum le-a poruncit Iosua: după ce au isprăvit fiii lui Israel de trecut Iordanul, au luat douăsprezece pietre din Iordan, precum Domnul poruncise lui Iosua, după numărul seminţiilor fiilor lui Israel şi le-au dus cu ei în tabără şi le-au pus acolo.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, καθότι ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ· καὶ ἀναλαβόντες δώδεκα λίθους ἐκ μέσου τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καθάπερ συνέταξε Κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ ἐν τῇ συντελείᾳ τῆς διαβάσεως τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ διεκόμισαν ἅμα ἑαυτοῖς εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν, καὶ ἀπέθηκαν ἐκεῖ.

verses.geez:
ወአቀመ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ካልኣተ ፡ እበነ ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወክልኤ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መካን ፡ ኀበ ፡ ቆማ
                  ፡ እገሪሆሙ ፡ ለካህናት ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸውሩ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ወሀለዋ ፡ ህየ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
verses.translation: And Joshua set also other twelve stones in Jordan itself, in the place that was under the feet of the priests that bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord; and there they are to this day.

translations.lxx: And Joshua set also other twelve stones in Jordan itself, in the place that was under the feet of the priests that bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord; and there they are to this day.
translations.kjv: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood: and they are there unto this day.
translations.ron: Iosua însă a pus alte douăsprezece pietre în mijlocul Iordanului, pe locul unde au stat picioarele preoţilor care duceau chivotul legământului Domnului, şi sunt acolo până în ziua de astăzi.
translations.grk: Ἔστησε δὲ Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἄλλους δώδεκα λίθους ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ, ἐν τῷ γενομένῳ τόπῳ ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας τῶν ἱερέων τῶν αἰρόντων τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης Κυρίου· καὶ εἰσὶν ἐκεῖ ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας.

verses.geez:
ወቆሙ ፡ እልክቱ ፡ ካህናት ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸውሩ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ እስከ ፡ ፈጸመ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ኵሎ
                  ፡ ዘአዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንግሮሙ ፡ ለሕዝብ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ ወአፍጠኑ
                  ፡ ዐዲወ ፡ ሕዝብ ።
verses.translation: And the priests that bore the ark of the covenant stood in Jordan, until Joshua had finished all that the Lord commanded him to report to the people; and the people hasted and passed over.

translations.lxx: And the priests that bore the ark of the covenant stood in Jordan, until Joshua had finished all that the Lord commanded him to report to the people; and the people hasted and passed over.
translations.kjv: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan, until everything was finished that the LORD commanded Joshua to speak unto the people, according to all that Moses commanded Joshua: and the people hasted and passed over.
translations.ron: Preoţii care duceau chivotul Domnului au stat în mijlocul Iordanului până ce a isprăvit Iosua toate câte îi poruncise Domnul să spună poporului, cum poruncise Moise lui Iosua. Şi poporul a grăbit să treacă Iordanul.
translations.grk: Εἱστήκεισαν δὲ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ αἴροντες τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ, ἕως οὗ συνετέλεσεν Ἰησοῦς πάντα ἃ ἐνετείλατο Κύριος ἀναγγεῖλαι τῷ λαῷ· καὶ ἔσπευσεν ὁ λαὸς, καὶ διέβησαν.

verses.geez: ወሶበ ፡ ተገምረ ፡ ዐዲወ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ዐደወት ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕግሂ ፡ ወእላክቱኒ ፡ እበን ፡ እለ ፡ እምቅድሜሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when all the people had passed over, that the ark of the covenant of the Lord passed over, and the stones before them.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when all the people had passed over, that the ark of the covenant of the Lord passed over, and the stones before them.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when all the people were clean passed over, that the ark of the LORD passed over, and the priests, in the presence of the people.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a trecut tot poporul, a trecut şi chivotul Domnului şi preoţii au mers iarăşi în fruntea poporului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς συνετέλεσε πᾶς ὁ λαὸς διαβῆναι, καὶ διέβη ἡ κιβωτὸς τῆς διαθήκης Κυρίου, καὶ οἱ λίθοι ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወዐደዉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወደቂቀ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወመንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ርሱያኒሆሙ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
                  በከመ ፡ አዘዞሙ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses commanded them.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Ruben, and the sons of Gad, and the half tribe of Manasse passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses commanded them.
translations.kjv: And the children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh, passed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spake unto them:
translations.ron: Atunci au trecut şi fiii lui Ruben, fiii lui Gad şi jumătate din seminţia lui Manase, gata de război, înaintea fiilor lui Israel, cum le poruncise Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ διέβησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ῥουβὴν, καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γὰδ, καὶ οἱ ἡμίσεις φυλῆς Μανασσῆ διεσκευασμένοι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς Μωυσῆς.

verses.geez: [፬፻-፻]ቅኑታኒሆሙ ፡ ለቀትል ፡ ዐደዉ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትቃተልዋ ፡ ለኢያሪኮ ፡ ሀገር ።
verses.translation: Forty thousand armed for battle went over before the Lord to war, to the city of Jericho.

translations.lxx: Forty thousand armed for battle went over before the Lord to war, to the city of Jericho.
translations.kjv: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
translations.ron: Ca la patruzeci de mii de oameni înarmaţi pentru război au trecut înaintea Domnului, ca să lupte împotriva cetăţii Ierihonului.
translations.grk: Τετρακισμύριοι εὔζωνοι εἰς μάχην διέβησαν ἐναντίον Κυρίου εἰς πόλεμον πρὸς τὴν Ἱεριχὼ πόλιν.

verses.geez:
ወበይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ አዕበዮ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘመደ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወፈርህዎ ፡ ከመ ፡ ሙሴ
                  ፡ አምጣነ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ሕያው ፡ ውእቱ ።
verses.translation: In that day the Lord magnified Joshua before all the people of Israel; and they feared him, as they did Moses, as long as he lived.

translations.lxx: In that day the Lord magnified Joshua before all the people of Israel; and they feared him, as they did Moses, as long as he lived.
translations.kjv: On that day the LORD magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they feared Moses, all the days of his life.
translations.ron: În ziua aceea a preamărit Domnul pe Iosua înaintea a tot neamul lui Israel şi s-au temut de dânsul cât a trăit, cum se temuseră şi de Moise.
translations.grk: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ηὔξησε Κύριος τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐναντίον τοῦ παντὸς γένους Ἰσραὴλ· καὶ ἐφοβοῦντο αὐτὸν, ὥσπερ Μωυσῆν, ὅσον χρόνον ἔζη.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
translations.ron: Apoi a grăit Domnul cu Iosua şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος τῷ Ἰησοῖ, λέγων,

verses.geez: አዝዞሙ ፡ ለካህናት ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸውሩ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይፃኡ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ።
verses.translation: Charge the priests that bear the ark of the covenant of the testimony of the Lord, to go up out of Jordan.

translations.lxx: Charge the priests that bear the ark of the covenant of the testimony of the Lord, to go up out of Jordan.
translations.kjv: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
translations.ron: "Porunceşte preoţilor care duc chivotul mărturiei Domnului, să iasă din Iordan".
translations.grk: ἔντειλαι τοῖς ἱερεῦσι τοῖς αἴρουσι τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης τοῦ μαρτυρίου Κυρίου, ἐκβῆναι ἐκ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.

verses.geez: [ወአዘዞሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለካህናት ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ፃኡ ፡ እምዮርዳንስ ።]
verses.translation: And Joshua charged the priests, saying, Go up out of Jordan.

translations.lxx: And Joshua charged the priests, saying, Go up out of Jordan.
translations.kjv: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, Come ye up out of Jordan.
translations.ron: Şi a poruncit Iosua preoţilor şi a zis: "Ieşiţi din Iordan!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνετείλατο Ἰησοῦς τοῖς ἱερεῦσι, λέγων, ἔκβητε ἐκ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ወፅኡ ፡ ካህናት ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸውሩ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡
                  ወኬዱ ፡ በእገሪሆሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ሮጸ ፡ ማየ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ወገብአ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መካናቲሁ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትካት ፡
                  ወበጽሐ ፡ እስከ ፡ ድንጋጊሁ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord were gone up out of Jordan, and set their feet upon the land, that the water of Jordan returned impetuously to its place, and went as before over all its banks.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord were gone up out of Jordan, and set their feet upon the land, that the water of Jordan returned impetuously to its place, and went as before over all its banks.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD were come up out of the midst of Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up unto the dry land, that the waters of Jordan returned unto their place, and flowed over all his banks, as they did before.
translations.ron: Şi cum au ieşit din Iordan preoţii, cei ce duceau chivotul legământului Domnului, şi şi-au pus picioarele pe uscat, apa Iordanului a pornit pe albia sa şi a curs ca mai înainte, până peste maluri.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐξέβησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ αἴροντες τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης Κυρίου ἐκ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, καὶ ἔθηκαν τοὺς πόδας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ὥρμησε τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κατὰ χώραν, καὶ ἐπορεύετο καθὰ χθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἡμέραν διʼ ὅλης τῆς κρηπίδος.

verses.geez:
ወአመ ፡ አሡሩ ፡ ለሠርቀ ፡ ቀዳሚ ፡ ወርኅ ፡ ወፅኡ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ እምነ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ወግዕዙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ ገልጋላ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ሠረቀ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኢያሪኮ ።
verses.translation: And the people went up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month; and the children of Israel encamped in Galgala in the region eastward from Jericho.

translations.lxx: And the people went up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month; and the children of Israel encamped in Galgala in the region eastward from Jericho.
translations.kjv: And the people came up out of Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and encamped in Gilgal, in the east border of Jericho.
translations.ron: Poporul a ieşit din Iordan în ziua a zecea a lunii întâi şi au tăbărât fiii lui Israel la Ghilgal, în partea de răsărit a Ierihonului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἀνέβη ἐκ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου δεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου· καὶ κατεστρατοπέδευσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ ἑν Γαλγάλοις κατὰ μέρος τὸ πρὸς ἡλίου ἀνατολὰς ἀπὸ τῆς Ἱεριχώ.

verses.geez: ወአቀሞን ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለእልክቱ ፡ እበን ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወክልኤ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገልጋላ ።
verses.translation: And Joshua set these twelve stones which he took out of Jordan, in Galgala,

translations.lxx: And Joshua set these twelve stones which he took out of Jordan, in Galgala,
translations.kjv: And those twelve stones, which they took out of Jordan, did Joshua pitch in Gilgal.
translations.ron: Iar cele douăsprezece pietre pe care le luaseră ei din Iordan, le-a aşezat Iosua în Ghilgal.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοὺς δώδεκα λίθους τούτους, οὓς ἔλαβεν ἐκ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, ἔστησεν Ἰησοῦς ἐν Γαλγάλοις,

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተስእሉክሙ ፡ ደቂቅክሙ ፡ ወይቤሉክሙ ፡ ምንትኑ ፡
                  እላንቱ ፡ እበን ፤
verses.translation: saying, When your sons ask you, saying, What are these stones?

translations.lxx: saying, When your sons ask you, saying, What are these stones?
translations.kjv: And he spake unto the children of Israel, saying, When your children shall ask their fathers in time to come, saying, What mean these stones?
translations.ron: Şi a zis fiilor lui Israel: "Când vă vor întreba fiii voştri mâine şi vor zice: Ce înseamnă aceste pietre?
translations.grk: λέγων, ὅταν ἐρωτῶσιν ὑμᾶς οἱ υἱοι ὑμῶν λέγοντες, τί εἰσιν οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι;

verses.geez: ዜንውዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቅክሙ ፡ ወበልዎሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ እንተ ፡ የብስ ፡ ዐደውናሁ ፡ ለዝንቱ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ።
verses.translation: Tell your sons, that Israel went over this Jordan on dry land,

translations.lxx: Tell your sons, that Israel went over this Jordan on dry land,
translations.kjv: Then ye shall let your children know, saying, Israel came over this Jordan on dry land.
translations.ron: Să spuneţi fiilor voştri: Israel a trecut prin Iordanul acesta, ca pe uscat,
translations.grk: Ἀναγγείλατε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν, ὅτι ἐπὶ ξηρᾶς διέβη Ἰσραὴλ τὸν Ἰορδάνην τοῦτον,

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ አይበሶ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለማየ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ቅድሜነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ነዐዱ ፡ በከመ ፡ ገብራ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ለባሕረ ፡ [ኤ]ርትራ ፡ እንተ ፡ አይበሳ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቅድሜነ ፡ እስከ ፡ ኀለፍነ ፤
verses.translation: when the Lord our God had dried up the water of Jordan from before them, until they had passed over; as the Lord our God did to the Red Sea, which the Lord our God dried up from before us, until we passed over.

translations.lxx: when the Lord our God had dried up the water of Jordan from before them, until they had passed over; as the Lord our God did to the Red Sea, which the Lord our God dried up from before us, until we passed over.
translations.kjv: For the LORD your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you, until ye were passed over, as the LORD your God did to the Red sea, which he dried up from before us, until we were gone over:
translations.ron: Căci Domnul Dumnezeul vostru a secat apele Iordanului înaintea lor, până ce le-au trecut, cum făcuse Domnul Dumnezeul vostru şi cu Marea Roşie, pe care a secat-o Domnul Dumnezeul nostru înaintea noastră. până ce am trecut-o,
translations.grk: ἀποξηράναντος Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἐκ τῶν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν, μέχρις οὗ διέβησαν· καθάπερ ἐποίησε Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν τὴν ἐρυθρὰν θάλασσαν, ἣν ἀπεξήρανε Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ἡμῶν ἔμπροσθεν ἡμῶν, ἕως παρήλθομεν·

verses.geez:
ከመ ፡ ያእምሩ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ምድር ፡ ከመ ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኀይሉ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወከመ ፡ ትፍርህዎ ፡
                  አንትሙኒ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክነ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ግብር ።
verses.translation: That all the nations of the earth might know, that the power of the Lord is mighty, and that ye might worship the Lord our God in every work.

translations.lxx: That all the nations of the earth might know, that the power of the Lord is mighty, and that ye might worship the Lord our God in every work.
translations.kjv: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the LORD, that it is mighty: that ye might fear the LORD your God for ever.
translations.ron: Ca să cunoască toate neamurile pământului că puterea Domnului este mare şi ca voi să vă temeţi de Domnul Dumnezeul vostru, în toată vremea".
translations.grk: Ὅπως γνῶσι πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἡ δύναμις τοῦ κυρίου ἰσχυρά ἐστι, καὶ ἵνα ὑμεῖς σέβησθε Κύριον τὸν Θεὸν ἡμῶν ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ.
